subject: Allow user to pass testing option via make file & use that to dump logs in coverage job (#5148)
reason: The change is purely build/CI plumbing: it adds a TEST_OPTIONS variable to the Makefile's test, test-modules, test-sentinel, test-cluster and lcov targets so extra flags can be passed to the runtest scripts, and uses it in the codecov workflow to pass --dump-logs. No Valkey server, command, replication, persistence or tool code changes, so there is no behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
